title: run_meta
description: Metadata for a single crabcc-autoresearch run, archived to lambda-normalization-census.

gpu_type.description: GPU model as reported by nvidia-smi.

budget_usd.description: Cost ceiling set before the run.

total_cost_usd.description: Actual total cost (GPU + LLM API) at run end.

best_val_bpb.description: Minimum val_bpb achieved across all steps. Null if no successful step.

published_at.description: UTC timestamp when artifacts were pushed to the census repo.
